question: 平台一共有多少个订单？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders

question: 处于已发货（shipped）状态的订单有多少？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'shipped'

question: 已取消或不可用的订单各有多少？
sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1

question: 支付记录的总条数是多少？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_payments

question: 平均分期数是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_installments), 2) AS avg_installments FROM order_payments

question: 各支付方式的使用次数统计？
sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC

question: 评价总数是多少？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_reviews

question: 给满分的评价有多少条？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 5

question: 平台一共有多少个商品？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM products

question: 卖家分布在多少个州？
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_state) AS cnt FROM sellers

question: 客户分布在多少个州？
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_state) AS cnt FROM customers

question: 最大的单笔支付金额是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(payment_value), 2) AS max_payment FROM order_payments

question: 单笔支付金额的平均值是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_payment FROM order_payments

question: 客户数量最多的十个州？
sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

question: 有多少条评价带有文字评论？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_reviews WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL AND review_comment_message != ''

question: 商品的平均重量是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(product_weight_g), 1) AS avg_weight FROM products WHERE product_weight_g IS NOT NULL

question: 各评分档位的评价数量分布？
sql: SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_reviews GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY review_score

question: 订单量最多的月份是哪一个？
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

question: 不同支付方式的平均分期数？
sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_installments), 2) AS avg_installments FROM order_payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_installments DESC

question: 已送达订单的平均配送时长是多少天？
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)), 1) AS avg_days FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date != ''

question: 各品类商品的订单明细条数排名前十？
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

question: 商品销量前十的名称与品类？
sql: SELECT i.product_id, t.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

question: 2018 年各品类商品的商品金额排名前十？
sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS amount FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp LIKE '2018%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各卖家州的商品金额排名？
sql: SELECT s.seller_state, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS amount FROM order_items i JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY amount DESC

question: 各州客户的支付总额排名？
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS gmv FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 各订单状态的支付总额分布？
sql: SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS gmv FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 各州客户的订单量排名前十？
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各州客户的客单价排名？
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY aov DESC

question: 评分低于 3 分的订单主要来自哪些州（数量前十）？
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.review_score < 3 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

question: 有评价的订单占全部订单的比例是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders), 4) AS ratio FROM order_reviews r

question: 各品类商品的商品平均价格排名前十？

question: 各州客户的平均评分排名？

question: 各卖家州覆盖了多少个商品品类？
